    Read control events after a cursor

    Source: R/control-client.R
    at_control_events.Rd

    Read control events after a cursor

    Usage

    at_control_events(
  handle,
  after = NULL,
  limit = 100L,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    handle

    An at_control_handle.

    after

    Optional event cursor ("<instance_id>:<seq>"); NULL returns the retained buffer. A cursor from another instance or older than the buffer yields resync_required = TRUE.

    limit

    Maximum number of events to return (a positive integer; the service caps a page at 500).

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    A list with events, next_cursor, resync_required, has_more and state_revision.

    See also

    Other control: at_control_capabilities(), at_control_close(), at_control_command(), at_control_connect(), at_control_request_status(), at_control_start(), at_control_state(), at_control_stop()
